type Numeric = { [n: number]: string } | { other: number };
function numberKey(x: Numeric): void {
  if (0 in x) console.log(x[0].toUpperCase());
  else console.log("no 0");
}
function stringKey(x: Numeric): void {
  if ("0" in x) console.log(x[0].toUpperCase());
}
function fraction(x: Numeric): void {
  if ("1.5" in x) console.log(x[1.5].toUpperCase());
}
function negative(x: Numeric): void {
  if ("-1" in x) console.log(x[-1].toUpperCase());
}
function arrays(x: string[] | { other: number }): void {
  if (0 in x) console.log(x[0].toUpperCase());
}
function dictionary(x: { [k: string]: number } | { other: string }): void {
  if ("q" in x) console.log(x.q);
}
function unknownKey(x: { a: number } | { b: string }): void {
  if ("c" in x) console.log(x.c);
  else console.log("no c");
}
function inherited(x: { toString(): string } | { other: number }): void {
  if ("toString" in x) console.log(x.toString());
}
function onlyIndex(x: { [n: number]: string }): void {
  if (1 in x) console.log(x[1].length);
}
numberKey({ 0: "a" });
numberKey({ other: 1 });
stringKey({ 0: "b" });
fraction({ 1.5: "c" });
negative({ [-1]: "d" });
arrays(["e"]);
dictionary({ q: 2 });
unknownKey({ a: 1 });
inherited({ other: 3 });
onlyIndex({ 1: "f" });
